scope: Independent source check and review of the two authored version-audit files. Main text, main-figure legends, cached preprint and existing Round 7 decision were checked. Supplemental panels and legends were not accessed; root reports their bounded retrieval stop.

checks.assessment: The PMC copy is labeled an author manuscript linked to the final publication; preprint and final are one project.
Attachment-method and second-clone additions, plus revised replication wording, are distinguished from previously extracted facts.
N/TERT-2G and clone-generation baricitinib are already in the preprint; continuing exposure and carryover are not inferred.
Weak attachment improvement is attributed to the final Discussion. It is not converted into no effect, full barrier repair or an extracted quantitative rescue.
The additional heterozygous clone supports the reported baseline phenotype only; independent donor replication and repeated pharmacologic rescue are not claimed.
Culture, clone and cell counts stay distinct. The revised statistics paragraph is not taken as proof of new data collection or a complete analysis-unit audit.
Pre-challenge SPCA1 correction is distinguished from delayed repair of established epidermal failure.
Figure 7 population wording is correctly flagged as inherited; the final Figure 6 receptor discrepancy remains unresolved rather than harmonized.
The unchanged clinical direction and optional mechanism module match the existing Round 7 development decision. No ruxolitinib clinical efficacy or allocation upgrade is inferred.
Structured records M01-M09 are present, strict JSON parses, cited XML sections exist, and the preprint hash matches the inspected file.

retained_evidence_limits: No direct S1/S4 panel or legend review; supplemental effect sizes and denominators remain null.
No publisher-formatted version comparison, raw-data reanalysis, culture-to-cell aggregation reconstruction or independent experimental replication.
Exact edited alleles, cell identity authentication and washout history remain unverified.
Passing the review establishes the accuracy of the bounded audit, not qualification of a full-barrier positive control.
